title: Ividiyo Ekhutshelweyo Ayidlali? Oonobangela Nezisombululo
description: Ividiyo oyikhuphelileyo ayidlali? Fumanisa oonobangela, ukusuka ekukhupheleni okungagqitywanga ukuya kwi-codec ye-HEVC, uze ulandele izisombululo ezilula.
photo2Caption: Zama olunye ukhetho lwevidiyo okanye esinye isidlali.
body:
Ividiyo ikhutshelwe ngempumelelo, kodwa xa uyivula kuvela umyalezo wempazamo, isikrini esimnyama, okanye umfanekiso oxingayo? Musa ukuncama ngokukhawuleza. Kukho oonobangela abambalwa abaqhelekileyo bokuba kutheni ividiyo ekhutshelweyo ingadlali, kwaye uninzi lwabo ungabalungisa ngokwakho ngemizuzu embalwa. Masibajonge omnye emva komnye.

Ukuze wazi, iifayile ze-MP4 ezikhutshelwe kwi-I Need Save zinobude bexesha obuchanekileyo kwaye zidlala kwii-app ze-gallery. Ngoko ukuba kukho ingxaki, unobangela udla ngokuba yenye yezi zinto zilandelayo.

1. Ukukhuphela akukagqitywa

Ezinye iividiyo zifuna ukusetyenzwa kuqala phambi kokukhutshelwa, umzekelo ividiyo nesandi sayo ziyadityaniswa, okanye i-stream iguqulelwa kwi-MP4. Ngexesha oku kusenzeka, iqhosha liya kubonisa Iyalungiselela…. Ukuba iphepha livaliwe okanye uqhagamshelo luyanqamka phambi kokuba ukukhuphela kugqitywe, ifayile inokonakala okanye ingaphelelanga.

Isisombululo: khuphela ividiyo kwakhona, linda de ukukhuphela kuqale ngokuzenzekelayo, uze uqinisekise ukuba kugqityiwe kuluhlu lokukhuphela lwe-browser phambi kokuba uvule ifayile.

2. I-codec yevidiyo ayixhaswa ziifowuni ezindala

Ezinye iividiyo ze-TikTok zisebenzisa i-codec ye-HEVC (H.265). Le codec yenza iifayile zisebenze kakuhle, kodwa iifowuni ezindala kakhulu zisenokungakwazi ukuyidlala kakuhle. Iimpawu zinokuba ngumfanekiso oxingayo, isikrini esimnyama esinesandi kuphela, okanye i-app ye-gallery yala ukuvula ifayile.

Isisombululo: khuphela kwakhona uze ukhethe olunye ukhetho lwevidiyo olukhoyo. Ukhetho lwe-H.264 ludlala phantse kuzo zonke izixhobo. Ungakhetha kwakhona i-resolution ephantsi ukuze ibe lula. Funda nenqaku elithi umahluko phakathi komgangatho wevidiyo we-360p, 720p ne-1080p ukuze likuncede ukhethe.

3. Ividiyo ayikaveli kwi-Gallery

Kwi-Android, iifayile zigcinwa kwifolda ethi Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo), kwaye i-app ye-Gallery ngamanye amaxesha ifuna ixesha elincinci ukuyibonisa. Usenokucinga ukuba ividiyo yonakele, kanti ifayile nje ayikafundwa.

Isisombululo: vula ifayile ngqo kwi-app yokulawula iifayile okanye kuluhlu lokukhuphela lwe-browser. Ungalinda kwakhona kancinci, uze uvule kwakhona i-app ye-Gallery.

4. Kwi-iPhone, ividiyo isekwi-app ethi Files

Abasebenzisi be-iPhone ne-iPad abasebenzisa i-Safari badla ngokudideka kuba ividiyo ayikho kwi-app ethi Photos. Oko kungenxa yokuba iifayile ezikhutshelweyo zingena kwi-app ethi Files → Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo).

  1. Vula i-app ethi Files uze ungene kwifolda ethi Downloads.
  2. Cofa ividiyo oyikhuphelileyo.
  3. Cofa Share (Yabelana).
  4. Khetha Save Video (Gcina Ividiyo).

Emva koko, ividiyo ingadlalwa kwi-app ethi Photos. Isikhokelo esipheleleyo malunga nendawo yeefayile sikwinqaku elithi iifayile ezikhutshelweyo zigcinwa phi.

5. Okukhutshelweyo asiyovidiyo

Kuluhlu lokhetho, ngaphandle kwevidiyo kukho Isandi kunye neFoto / Umfanekiso omncinci. Ukuba ngempazamo ukhethe isandi, okugciniweyo yifayile yesandi engenamfanekiso. Ukuba ukhethe umfanekiso omncinci, okugciniweyo ngumfanekiso wesiciko kuphela.

Isisombululo: phinda inkqubo uze uqinisekise ukuba ucofa ukhetho lwevidiyo olunomgangatho owufunayo.

6. Indawo yokugcina igcwele okanye isidlali sinengxaki

Indawo yokugcina ephantse yagcwala inokwenza ifayile igcinwe ingaphelelanga. Ii-app zokudlala okanye iinkqubo zokusebenza ezindala nazo ngamanye amaxesha zinengxaki xa zivula iividiyo ezithile.

Isisombululo: khulula indawo encinci yokugcina, hlaziya inkqubo ne-app ye-gallery ukuba kukho uhlaziyo, uze ukhuphele ividiyo kwakhona.

Inyathelo elikhawulezayo elidla ngokunceda: cima ifayile eneengxaki, kopa ilinki kwakhona kwiqhosha elithi Yabelana, uze ukhuphele kwakhona ngolunye ukhetho lomgangatho.

Indlela yokukhuphela kwakhona ngendlela efanelekileyo

  1. Kwi-app yemidiya yoluntu, cofa Yabelana (Share) uze ucofe Kopa ilinki (Copy link).
  2. Vula iphepha lokukhuphela le-I Need Save.
  3. Ncamathisela ilinki okanye ucofe Ncamathisela, uze ucofe Khuphela.
  4. Khetha ukhetho lwevidiyo olufanelekileyo, uze ulinde ukuba kuvela Iyalungiselela….

Khumbula ukuba umxholo wabucala, umxholo ofuna ukungena, okanye umxholo othintelwe ngokommandla awunakukhutshelwa. Gcina iividiyo kuphela ukuze uzisebenzisele wena, kwaye ukuba ufuna ukuzipapasha kwakhona, cela imvume kumdali uze ukhankanye igama lakhe.

Imibuzo ebuzwa rhoqo

Kutheni kukho isandi kodwa umfanekiso umnyama?

Ngokuqhelekileyo kungenxa yokuba ifowuni ayiyixhasi i-codec yaloo vidiyo, umzekelo i-HEVC kwisixhobo esidala kakhulu. Zama ukukhuphela kwakhona ngolunye ukhetho lwevidiyo.

Ngaba ubude bevidiyo ekhutshelweyo bunokuba neempazamo?

Iifayile ze-MP4 ezivela kwi-I Need Save zinobude bexesha obuchanekileyo. Ukuba ubude bubonakala bungaqhelekanga, kusenokwenzeka ukuba ukukhuphela akukagqitywa, ngoko zama ukukhuphela kwakhona.

Ividiyo iyadlala kwi-laptop kodwa hayi kwifowuni, kutheni?

Kunokwenzeka kakhulu ukuba kungenxa yomahluko kwinkxaso yee-codec kwezi zixhobo zombini. Zama ukukhetha olunye ukhetho lwevidiyo xa ukhuphela ividiyo yefowuni yakho.
